INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Writing 2.3.1 Essay writing.

2. In INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Mix random languages with no purpose
   B. Avoid speaking to classmates
   C. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day
   D. Only memorise without using the language

3. When practising Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening and Speaking 3.1.1 Attentive listening.

----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Reading 7.2.1 Reading for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Writing 7.3.1 Writing for information and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
